> This directory contains strategic white papers for Gainwell Technologies' Enterprise Architecture Practice. These documents provide comprehensive analysis and recommendations on key technology, architecture, and business strategy topics.

### Business

Strategic business analysis and organizational white papers, including:

- Enterprise strategy and digital transformation frameworks
- Business process optimization and governance models
- Organizational change management and adoption strategies
- Cost-benefit analysis and investment planning

[strategy/white-papers/README.md#engineering]

### Engineering

- **[AWS API Management Strategy for Enterprise Adoption](engineering/aws-api-management-strategy.md)** - Strategic blueprint for establishing a governed AWS API Management capability with phased domain onboarding and control alignment
- **[AI Agent Engineering Best Practices](engineering/ai-agent-engineering.md)** - Documentation-as-Code and Context Management for AI-Driven Development
- **[Enterprise Golden Path Strategy](engineering/enterprise-golden-path-strategy.md)** - Enterprise blueprint for governing autonomous AI application development through Golden Paths and intent-to-infrastructure
- **[Enterprise Architecture Verification and Fitness Functions](engineering/enterprise-architecture-verification-strategy.md)** - Concurrent strategy for ensuring every Golden Path produces verifiable, compliant, and maintainable systems through automated conformance gates, fitness functions, policy-as-code, and runtime monitors
- **[GitHub Markdown Content Enablement in Microsoft 365 Copilot](engineering/github-markdown-m365-copilot-enablement.md)** - Architecture options for grounding M365 Copilot on GitHub-hosted Markdown documentation, including Graph connectors, SharePoint sync, plugins, and custom RAG evaluation
- **[BDD-Driven SDLC: From Product Requirements to Executable Specifications](engineering/bdd-lifecycle-strategy.md)** - End-to-end strategy for using BDD Gherkin specifications as the authoritative requirement format across the SDLC, with AI-assisted decomposition, Azure DevOps integration, and polyglot test execution
- **[Spec-Driven Development: Industry Convergence and Gainwell's Composite Framework](engineering/spec-driven-development-strategy.md)** - Synthesis paper defining Spec-Driven Development as an industry pattern, surveying GitHub Spec Kit, AWS Kiro, and BMAD-METHOD, and positioning Gainwell's composite model (BDD lifecycle, multi-axis decomposition, agent dispatch) against the external landscape
- **[Technology Convergence Framework](engineering/technology-convergence-framework.md)** - Applying M&A integration archetypes (Holding, Preservation, Symbiosis, Absorption) to technology convergence decisions, with decision criteria and a Technology Convergence Register template for EA portfolio tracking
- **[Competing Directives: Engineering Convergence in AI-Assisted Review Pipelines](engineering/ai-review-pipeline-convergence-strategy.md)** - Strategic analysis of the author-AI/reviewer-AI adversarial dynamic, the convergence loop cost model, and how to architect AI review pipelines before the failure patterns compound across teams

### Operations

- **[Regional Disaster Recovery and the True Cost of Resilience](operations/true-cost-of-regional-resilience.md)** - Enterprise-scale regional failover strategy analysis
- **[HITRUST Certification Strategy for Hybrid Multi-Tenant Platforms](operations/hitrust-certification-strategy-hybrid-platforms.md)** - Strategic framework for scalable HITRUST certification across shared and dedicated environments
- **[Enterprise Architecture Content Publishing Strategy: Bridging GitHub and Microsoft 365](operations/ea-content-publishing-strategy.md)** - Strategic white paper on enabling enterprise-wide consumption of EA guidance through secure one-way publishing from GitHub to SharePoint Online
- **[Enterprise Architecture Content Publishing Implementation Plan](operations/ea-content-publishing-implementation.md)** - Technical implementation plan with infrastructure provisioning, pipeline development, security configuration, and operational procedures for the EA publishing strategy

### Technology

- **[Enterprise AI Automation Governance Strategy](technology/enterprise-ai-automation-governance-strategy.md)** - Strategic governance framework for enterprise AI and automation capabilities, covering the four-tier taxonomy, federated governance model, and SDLC role model for citizen builders
- **[Mono-Repository vs Poly-Repository Strategy for GitHub-Hosted Architectures](technology/mono-vs-poly-repository-strategy.md)** - Decision-oriented trade-off analysis and framework for repository topology, release independence, and GitHub release feature integration

### Security

- **[GitHub Repository Security Governance](security/github-repository-security-governance.md)** - Protecting Enterprise Architecture intellectual property through role-based, least-privileged access controls and Zero Trust Architecture principles
- **[GitHub Repository Security Governance Implementation Plan](security/github-repository-security-implementation.md)** - Actionable implementation plan with immediate, short-term, and long-term actions for establishing repository security governance
- **[Go-Forward Strategy for HITRUST Certification](security/hitrust-certification-strategy.md)** - Strategic framework for achieving and maintaining HITRUST i1 certification in a hybrid multi-cloud environment
- **[Identity Proofing and Verification Strategy](security/identity-proofing-verification-strategy.md)** - Vendor-agnostic strategic analysis of IPV capabilities for workforce and customer identity verification
- **[Automated Security EA Integration](security/automated-security-ea-integration.md)** - Proactive architecture guidance through ServiceNow automation and embedded security workflows
- **[Security Standards Enablement Brief](security/security-standards-enablement-brief.md)** - Intake-focused proposal package with Top 20 candidate standards, supporting source-document index, and wave-based sequencing for standards governance

## White Paper Template

The standardized [White Paper Template](../../resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/white-paper.md) provides a consistent structure for creating professional strategy documents. The template includes:

- Executive summary format
- Comprehensive analysis structure
- Implementation planning framework
- Cost-benefit analysis guidelines
- Professional formatting standards
page_texts.9:
[strategy/white-papers/README.md#getting-started]

## Getting Started

To create a new white paper:

1. Use the [White Paper Template](../../resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/white-paper.md)
2. Replace all `[bracketed placeholders]` with your specific content
3. Follow the established section structure and formatting guidelines
4. Include appropriate cost disclaimers and risk assessments
5. Submit for technical and business review before publication

For questions about the template or white paper development process, contact the Enterprise Architecture Practice.
